title: Laminated Custard Pastry Slice
description: One original low-poly laminated custard pastry slice, counted as one complete static food prop. Three broad flat golden baked sheets each have a continuous closed body and four real thin stepped perimeter ridges. Two narrower continuous scalloped cream bands sit between them. Four complete opposed planar contact patches form one grounded support chain; two genuine continuous open peripheral gaps expose the cream and undersides of the pastry overhangs. The top is a whole lightly domed chamfered crust face rather than a label or floating icing card. Five separately editable closed meshes and three opaque constant untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. All geometry newly authored, not a recoloured croissant, bread slice, folded dough, repeated scene prop or imported food model. No plate, fork, wrapper, garnish, text, texture, crumbs, animation or scene. Static stylized food appearance only: no recipe, ingredient, nutrition, allergen, taste, edible product, food safety, hygiene, baking, handling, softness, deformation, manufacture or compatibility claim. Dimensions describe visual game geometry only.
